en.answer:
In that case, since <<5098>> is a Normal Spell Card, it is sent to the Graveyard normally.

However, the effect of that <<5098>> that was sent to the Graveyard cannot be activated by the effect that allows you to activate it during the Main Phase of your next turn.
en.question: If <<5098>> is revealed as the top card of the Deck by the effect of <<6660>>, can its effect be activated?
en.title: If <<5098>> is revealed as the top card of the Deck by the effect of <<6660>>, can its effect be activated?

ja.answer:
「<<6660>>」の効果によって確認した自分のデッキの一番上のカードが「<<5098>>」だった場合、「<<5098>>」は通常魔法カードですので、通常通り墓地へと送られます。

しかしながら、その墓地へ送った「<<5098>>」の効果を『次の自分のターンのメインフェイズ時にその通常魔法カードの効果を発動する事ができる』効果によって発動する事はできません。
